title: An Outline of Occult Science
author: Rudolf Steiner
description: An Outline of Occult Science (Die Geheimwissenschaft im Umriss, 1910) by Rudolf Steiner (1861-1925), founder of Anthroposophy, here in an early authorised English translation. One of Steiner's four foundational books, it presents the results of his spiritual-scientific (supersensible) research in systematic form. It describes the human being as composed of physical body, etheric body, astral body and ego, the states of sleep and death and the life between death and rebirth. Its central part is a vast cosmology of the evolution of the world and humanity through successive planetary conditions (Old Saturn, Old Sun, Old Moon and Earth, with future Jupiter, Venus and Vulcan), the work of spiritual hierarchies, the Lemurian and Atlantean epochs and the post-Atlantean cultures, and the deed of Christ as the turning point of earth evolution. A final section describes the path of knowledge and initiation. It is a cornerstone of anthroposophical teaching.
